name: Instagram Scraper
description: Instagram scraper for Python and the command line: public profile stats (followers, following, posts, bio, verified badge) for up to 50 accounts per run, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: profiles
commands.help: public profile stats for one or more Instagram accounts
commands.description: Public Instagram profile stats — followers, following, posts, bio.

inputs.name: usernames
inputs.description: Handles or profile URLs (one per line).

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many profiles to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered profiles.
